<title level="1" right="Class Feature 19">[Oracular Clarity](/Classes.aspx?ID=14)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Advanced Player's Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=39) pg. 66

**Class** Oracle
</column>

---

You now fully grasp the nature of the divine power behind your mystery, allowing you to work magic akin to miracles. Add two common 10th-level divine spells to your repertoire. You gain a single 10th-level spell slot you can use to cast one of those two spells using oracle spellcasting. You don't gain more 10th-level spells as you level up, unlike other spell slots, and you can't use 10th-level slots with abilities that give you more spell slots or that let you cast spells without expending spell slots. You can take the [Oracular Providence](/Feats.aspx?ID=1510) feat to gain a second slot.
name: Oracular Clarity
